Kinds: no slime shape / model, no boss, no ranged; positive numbers; stats rise with MonsterLevel inside a field; HP / Damage / XP / Gold lie between the level neighbours on the plain ladder (Slime Lv2, Goblin Lv12, Skeleton Lv26; Scale < 1.2) or the big ladder (Slime Prince Lv5, Goblin Brute Lv18, Skeleton Knight Lv30; Scale >= 1.2), equal allowed; Float on Jellyfish / Cave Bat; golem Scale >= 1.8 and Count <= 3. Loot: every item exists, P in (0, 1], the field's material (Material, Sell > 0, in Config.Loot.Order), scroll / transfer / potion / weapon chances at most the Goblin's (plain) or Goblin Brute's (big), a weapon row (tier <= 4) only on the golem. Barks: 4 moments with short lines (<= 24 chars; A23-74 <= 2 words and 12 letters, not shared with another kind), a bubble family. MonsterTypeOrder once each, QuestAs resolves, English-only text (printable ASCII, the ellipsis and ~).
limitations: Config data only: the spawn code (MonsterService), the maps / panels that read Config.ZoneOrder and the client bubbles are not run here (they are covered by test_map_v2, test_monster_bark and the season suites).
